title: Bambu Lab Chamber Temperature Drift
app: Bambu Lab printers, Prusa Connect, OctoPrint, Moonraker, LaserWeb, CNC.js, drybox sensors, and workshop telemetry via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=bambulab:job
| stats avg(chamber_temp_c) as avg_chamber_temp_c, stdev(chamber_temp_c) as temp_sd_c by printer material
| where avg_chamber_temp_c>35 OR temp_sd_c>2
| sort - temp_sd_c
description: Uses Bambu chamber telemetry telemetry to monitor temperature stability during enclosed prints in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for jobs where chamber conditions are wandering too much, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Bambu chamber telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Printer and material table of chamber temperature variation.
grandmaExplanation: It totals temperature stability during enclosed prints so you can spot jobs where chamber conditions are wandering too much before it becomes annoying.
